I am an economist and faculty member at the [Escuela de Gobierno y Economía](https://www.up.edu.mx), Universidad Panamericana.

My research studies **land tenure and agricultural conservation**, using causal machine-learning methods (double/debiased machine learning, heterogeneous treatment effects, and sensitivity analysis) applied to Peru's National Agricultural Census (CENAGRO).

I hold a PhD in Economics from ITAM. I teach development economics and international trade.

## Research interests

Development economics · Political economy · Agricultural and environmental economics · Land tenure and property rights

## Recent publications

- "Monetary Policy Committees, Independence, and Influence." *Games* (2026). [DOI](https://doi.org/10.3390/g17010006)
